```{r}
raw_data = load("raw_statcast2024.RData")
players = load("chadwick_players.RData")

```

```{r}
statcast2024 <-
  raw_statcast2024 |> 
  dplyr::filter(game_type == "R") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    strikes >= 0 & strikes < 3 & 
      balls >= 0 & balls < 4 & 
      outs_when_up >= 0 & outs_when_up < 3) |>
  dplyr::arrange(game_date, game_pk, at_bat_number, pitch_number)
```

```{r}
statcast2024 <-
  statcast2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    BaseRunner = 
      paste0(1*(!is.na(on_1b)),1*(!is.na(on_2b)),1*(!is.na(on_3b)))) |>
  dplyr::rename(Outs = outs_when_up)
```


```{r}
statcast2024_small = statcast2024 %>% 
  select(pitch_type, game_date, pitcher, description, events, balls, strikes, pitch_number, pitch_name, hit_location, delta_pitcher_run_exp, inning, inning_topbot, Outs, at_bat_number) %>% 
  rename(pitcher_idx = pitcher)
```


```{r}
player2024_id <-
  unique(
    c(statcast2024$batter, statcast2024$pitcher
      ))

player2024_lookup <-
  chadwick_players |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(key_mlbam) & key_mlbam %in% player2024_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FullName = paste(name_first, name_last),
    Name = stringi::stri_trans_general(FullName, "Latin-ASCII"))
save(player2024_lookup, file = "player2024_lookup.RData")
  
```

```{r}
allstar_pitchers_2024 <- tibble(
  name = c(
    "Tyler Anderson", "Corbin Burnes", "Garrett Crochet", "Tanner Houck", "Seth Lugo",
    "Clay Holmes", "Mason Miller", "Cole Ragans", 
    "Tarik Skubal", "Kirby Yates", "Logan Gilbert", "Emmanuel Clase", "Andrés Muñoz", "Max Fried", "Hunter Greene", "Shota Imanaga", "Reynaldo López", "Christopher Sánchez", "Paul Skenes", "Logan Webb", "Jeff Hoffman", "Tanner Scott", "Matt Strahm", "Robert Suarez", "Kyle Finnegan", "Tyler Glasnow", "Ryan Helsley", "Chris Sale", "Ranger Suárez", "Zach Wheeler"
  )
)
all_star_pitcher_lookup = player2024_lookup %>% # gets the name and idx of all star pitchers
  filter(FullName %in% allstar_pitchers_2024$name) %>% 
  rename(pitcher_idx = key_mlbam) %>% 
  select(pitcher_idx, Name)
```

```{r}
pitches_sorted = statcast2024_small %>% #sorts all pitches by game and pitch order
  filter(pitcher_idx %in% all_star_pitcher_lookup$pitcher_idx) %>%
  arrange(pitcher_idx, game_date, pitch_number) %>% 
  group_by(pitcher_idx, game_date, at_bat_number) %>% 
  mutate(pitches_in_ab = n()) %>% 
  filter(pitches_in_ab >= 3)
```

```{r}
pitcher_sequences <- pitches_sorted %>%
  group_by(pitcher_idx, game_date, inning, at_bat_number) %>% #groups by individual pitcher and at bat number
  arrange(pitch_number, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    next1 = lead(pitch_type, 1), #finds pitch type of next pitch, if doesnt exist drops it
    next2 = lead(pitch_type, 2),
    sequence = paste(pitch_type, next1, next2, sep = "-"),
    by_group = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(next2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(pitcher_idx, sequence) %>% #re groups by pitcher and sequence
  summarise(
    total_delta_run_exp = sum(delta_pitcher_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE), #sums run expectancy (how is this calculated?)
    n = n(),                                   # number of times sequence occurred
    avg_delta_run_exp = mean(delta_pitcher_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(n>50) %>% # arbitrary value, gets rid of insignificant low frequency sequences
  slice_max(order_by = avg_delta_run_exp, n=3) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    Name = all_star_pitcher_lookup$Name[
    match(pitcher_idx, all_star_pitcher_lookup$pitcher_idx) #match the pitcher idx to a name
    ]
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Name))
```
```{r}
highest_sequence_instance <- pitches_sorted %>%
  arrange(pitcher_idx, game_date, inning, pitch_number) %>%
  group_by(pitcher_idx, game_date, at_bat_number) %>%
  mutate(
    next1 = lead(pitch_type, 1),
    next2 = lead(pitch_type, 2),
    next1_delta = lead(delta_pitcher_run_exp, 1),
    next2_delta = lead(delta_pitcher_run_exp, 2),
    sequence = paste(pitch_type, next1, next2, sep = "-"),
    total_sequence_delta = delta_pitcher_run_exp + next1_delta + next2_delta,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_sequence_delta, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Name = all_star_pitcher_lookup$Name[
      match(pitcher_idx, all_star_pitcher_lookup$pitcher_idx)
    ]
  ) %>%
  select(Name, pitcher_idx, game_date, pitch_number, sequence, total_sequence_delta, inning, inning_topbot, Outs, description)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ensure join key types match
pitcher_random_sequences <- pitcher_random_sequences %>%
  mutate(pitcher_idx = as.integer(pitcher_idx))

baseline_random3_mean <- baseline_random3_mean %>%
  mutate(pitcher = as.integer(pitcher))

# keep sequence counts, then LEFT JOIN the baseline + names from baseline_random3_mean
baseline_per_pitcher <- pitcher_random_sequences %>%
  group_by(pitcher_idx) %>%
  summarise(n_sequences = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    baseline_random3_mean %>%
      transmute(pitcher, pitcher_name, baseline_mean_dpre3),
    by = c("pitcher_idx" = "pitcher")
  ) %>%
  # match your old column names if you want to keep downstream code unchanged:
  rename(
    Name = pitcher_name,
    baseline_avg_delta = baseline_mean_dpre3
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Name))

# quick check
dplyr::glimpse(baseline_per_pitcher)

```

```{r}
pitcher_comparison <- pitcher_sequences %>%
  left_join(baseline_per_pitcher, by = c("pitcher_idx", "Name")) %>%
  mutate(
    improvement_over_baseline = avg_delta_run_exp - baseline_avg_delta
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(improvement_over_baseline))

pitcher_comparison
```

```{r}
sequence_counts <- pitches_sequences %>%
  group_by(pitcher, sequence) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = n, n = 10) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1) build a clean full name in the lookup
lookup_names <- all_star_pitcher_lookup %>%
  mutate(
    pitcher_idx = as.integer(pitcher_idx),
    pitcher_name = str_squish(
      str_to_title(
        paste(coalesce(name_first, ""), coalesce(name_last, ""))
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(pitcher_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%         
  select(pitcher_idx, pitcher_name)

# 2) join onto your counts table
sequence_counts_named <- sequence_counts %>%
  mutate(pitcher = as.integer(pitcher)) %>%
  left_join(lookup_names, by = c("pitcher" = "pitcher_idx"))


sequence_counts_named_as <- sequence_counts_named %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pitcher_name))

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

set.seed(479)
B <- 1000


pitchers_included <- sequence_counts_named_as %>%
  distinct(pitcher) %>%
  mutate(pitcher = as.integer(pitcher)) %>%
  pull(pitcher)


dat_pitchers <- raw_statcast2024 %>%
  transmute(
    pitcher = as.integer(pitcher),
    delta_pitcher_run_exp = delta_pitcher_run_exp  
  ) %>%
  filter(pitcher %in% pitchers_included, !is.na(delta_pitcher_run_exp))

# 1000 random triples per pitcher and average 
baseline_random3_draws <- dat_pitchers %>%
  semi_join(valid_counts %>% filter(n_valid >= 3), by = "pitcher") %>%
  group_by(pitcher) %>%
  reframe(
    draw = 1:B,
    baseline_dpre3 = replicate(
      B,
      mean(sample(delta_pitcher_run_exp, size = 3, replace = FALSE))
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pitcher_names <- sequence_counts_named_as %>%
  distinct(pitcher, pitcher_name)

baseline_random3_draws_named <- baseline_random3_draws %>%
  left_join(pitcher_names, by = "pitcher") %>%
  select(pitcher, pitcher_name, draw, baseline_dpre3)

baseline_random3_mean <- baseline_random3_draws_named %>%
  group_by(pitcher, pitcher_name) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_mean_dpre3 = mean(baseline_dpre3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_draws = dplyr::n(),         
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- baseline_random3_mean %>%
  filter(!is.na(pitcher_name), !is.na(baseline_mean_dpre3))

# All-Star baseline mean 
allstar_baseline_mean <- mean(df$baseline_mean_dpre3, na.rm = TRUE)

# Overall average from all pitches 
stopifnot(exists("raw_statcast2024"), "delta_pitcher_run_exp" %in% names(raw_statcast2024))
overall_allpitch_dpre <- raw_statcast2024 %>%
  summarise(overall_dpre = mean(delta_pitcher_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(overall_dpre)

# lines
ref_lines <- tibble(
  label = factor(c("All pitches", "All-Star baseline mean"),
                 levels = c("All pitches", "All-Star baseline mean")),
  y = c(overall_allpitch_dpre, allstar_baseline_mean)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(pitcher_name, baseline_mean_dpre3),
               y = baseline_mean_dpre3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(data = ref_lines,
             aes(yintercept = y, color = label, linetype = label),
             size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All pitches" = "red",
                                "All-Star baseline mean" = "black")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("All pitches" = "solid",
                                   "All-Star baseline mean" = "dashed")) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline mean dPRE (3 random pitches) by pitcher",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Red: all pitches = %.4f   |   Dashed: All-Star baseline mean = %.4f",
      overall_allpitch_dpre, allstar_baseline_mean
    ),
    x = "Pitcher",
    y = "Baseline mean dPRE3 (runs; higher is better for pitcher)",
    color = NULL, linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

```
```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

df <- baseline_random3_mean %>%
  filter(!is.na(pitcher_name), !is.na(baseline_mean_dpre3))

pc0 <- pitcher_comparison %>%
  rename_with(~"pitcher_name", any_of(c("pitcher_name","Name"))) %>%
  mutate(pitcher_name = str_squish(pitcher_name)) %>%
  select(pitcher_name, avg_delta_run_exp) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pitcher_name), !is.na(avg_delta_run_exp))

# exactly 3 points per pitcher; drop pitchers without 3
keepers <- pc0 %>% count(pitcher_name, name = "n_seq") %>%
  filter(n_seq == 3) %>% pull(pitcher_name)

df_plot <- df %>% filter(pitcher_name %in% keepers)
pc_plot <- pc0 %>% filter(pitcher_name %in% keepers)

# x-axis order from baseline
x_levels <- df_plot %>% arrange(baseline_mean_dpre3) %>% pull(pitcher_name)
df_plot <- df_plot %>% mutate(pitcher_name = factor(pitcher_name, levels = x_levels))
pc_plot <- pc_plot %>% mutate(pitcher_name = factor(pitcher_name, levels = x_levels))

# reference lines
allstar_baseline_mean <- mean(df_plot$baseline_mean_dpre3, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(exists("raw_statcast2024"), "delta_pitcher_run_exp" %in% names(raw_statcast2024))
overall_allpitch_dpre <- raw_statcast2024 %>%
  summarise(overall_dpre = mean(delta_pitcher_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(overall_dpre)
mean_seq_avg_delta <- mean(pc_plot$avg_delta_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- LEGEND LABELS (your order) ----
legend_levels <- c(
  "All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE",
  "Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE)",
  "Mean avg ΔPRE (All Pitches)",
  "All-Star baseline avg ΔPRE",
  "Mean sequence avg ΔPRE"
)

# map aesthetics to those labels
ref_lines <- tibble(
  label = factor(c("Mean avg ΔPRE (All Pitches)",
                   "All-Star baseline avg ΔPRE",
                   "Mean sequence avg ΔPRE"),
                 levels = legend_levels),
  y = c(overall_allpitch_dpre, allstar_baseline_mean, mean_seq_avg_delta)
)

ggplot() +
  # blue dots = All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE (per pitcher)
  geom_point(
    data = df_plot,
    aes(x = pitcher_name, y = baseline_mean_dpre3, color = "All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE"),
    size = 2
  ) +
  # green dots = Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE) (three points per pitcher)
  geom_point(
    data = pc_plot,
    aes(x = pitcher_name, y = avg_delta_run_exp, color = "Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE)"),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
    size = 2.2, shape = 16
  ) +
  # reference lines
  geom_hline(
    data = ref_lines,
    aes(yintercept = y, color = label, linetype = label),
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = legend_levels,
    values = c(
      "All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE"   = "red",
      "Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE)"    = "forestgreen",
      "Mean avg ΔPRE (All Pitches)"  = "blue",
      "All-Star baseline avg ΔPRE"   = "black",
      "Mean sequence avg ΔPRE"       = "purple"
    )
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    breaks = legend_levels,
    values = c(
      "All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE"   = "blank",
      "Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE)"    = "blank",
      "Mean avg ΔPRE (All Pitches)"  = "solid",
      "All-Star baseline avg ΔPRE"   = "dashed",
      "Mean sequence avg ΔPRE"       = "dotted"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "All-Star Random 3 avg ΔPRE vs Top 3 Sequences avg ΔPRE",
    x = "Pitcher",
    y = "ΔPRE (runs; higher is better for pitcher)",
    color = "Key", linetype = "Key"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape    = c(16, 16, NA, NA, NA),
        linetype = c("blank", "blank", "solid", "dashed", "dotted"),
        size     = c(3, 3, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
      ),
      nrow = 2
    ),
    linetype = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE)   # ensure NA/unused x levels are dropped


```

```{r}
# ── Tarik Skubal: sequences vs his All-Star Random 3 baseline ──
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# 1) Find Tarik Skubal in the baseline table
skubal_baseline <- baseline_random3_mean %>%
  mutate(pitcher_name = str_squish(pitcher_name)) %>%
  filter(str_to_lower(pitcher_name) == "tarik skubal")

if (nrow(skubal_baseline) == 0) {
  stop("Tarik Skubal not found in baseline_random3_mean$pitcher_name.")
}

skubal_line <- skubal_baseline$baseline_mean_dpre3[1]

# 2) Standardize pitcher_comparison columns
pc_cols <- names(pitcher_comparison)
name_col <- intersect(pc_cols, c("pitcher_name","Name"))[1]
seq_col  <- intersect(pc_cols, c("sequence","seq","seq3","sequence_name","Sequence"))[1]
if (is.na(name_col) || is.na(seq_col)) {
  stop("pitcher_comparison must have a name column {pitcher_name|Name} AND a sequence column {sequence|seq|seq3|sequence_name|Sequence}.")
}

pc_skubal <- pitcher_comparison %>%
  rename(pitcher_name = all_of(name_col),
         sequence_lab = all_of(seq_col)) %>%
  mutate(
    pitcher_name = str_squish(pitcher_name),
    sequence_lab = str_squish(as.character(sequence_lab))
  ) %>%
  filter(str_to_lower(pitcher_name) == "tarik skubal",
         !is.na(sequence_lab),
         !is.na(avg_delta_run_exp)) %>%
  group_by(sequence_lab) %>%
  summarise(avg_delta_run_exp = mean(avg_delta_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

if (nrow(pc_skubal) == 0) {
  stop("No sequence rows with avg_delta_run_exp for Tarik Skubal in pitcher_comparison.")
}

# 3) Plot (make it tall in Rmd: e.g., {r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10})
ggplot(pc_skubal,
       aes(x = reorder(sequence_lab, avg_delta_run_exp),
           y = avg_delta_run_exp)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = skubal_line,
             color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Tarik Skubal — Sequence avg ΔPRE vs All-Star Random 3 baseline",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed blue line: Random 3 avg ΔPRE = %.4f", skubal_line),
    x = "Sequence",
    y = "avg ΔPRE (runs; higher is better for pitcher)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
